The MDE of 0.5 contacts per 100 is also set for the guardrail rather than the primary success metric, so the power calculation does not cover the stated primary outcome.","evidence_quote":"Duration: 3 weeks. MDE: 0.5 contacts per 100, power 80%.","citations":["experimentation-standards#pre-registration"],"recommendation":"Align the duration with the success-metric window, and pre-register the MDE, power, and sample size for the primary metric (Delivery CSAT)."}]}
